name: Jiangxi Redboard Tech Co. Ltd.
summary: JiangXi Redboard Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sales printed circuit boards (PCBs) products. The company’s products include HDI boards, rigid PCBs, FPCs, RFPCs, and IC substrates. The company serves the communication, automotive, industrial control, and medical industries. It exports its products in Hang Kong, Singapore, Japan, Europe and the United States. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Ji'an, China. Jiangxi Redboard Technology Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Red Board Limited.
